why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 0.82 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 11.5 points of that tide, a tailwind for Tim Kennedy.

D.t: Tim Kennedy leads by 33.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 89,743 votes; a one point swing is about 1,334 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +26.4 and D +40.9. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
